title: Measure of a projection box for a measure of product form ν(A) = ∫_E σ(A − t) dH^k(t)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let G ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with orthogonal projections p := G.starProjection and q := G^⊥.starProjection, let ν, σ be measures on ℝ^P and E ⊆ G a Borel set, H^k := μHE[k]. Assume σ(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥) = 0 and ν(A) = ∫_E σ(A − t) dH^k(t) (Lean: ∫⁻ t in E, σ((fun y => t + y)⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for all Borel sets C, B ⊆ ℝ^P: ν(p⁻¹(C) ∩ q⁻¹(B)) = H^k(E ∩ C)·σ(B).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (G : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (E : Set (Euclid P)), σ (Gᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ (G : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in E, σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → ∀ C B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → MeasurableSet B → ν (G.starProjection ⁻¹' C ∩ Gᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = μHE[k] (E ∩ C) * σ B
